notes: Horizontal front-loading box: 125.2 cm W x 55.1 cm H x 61 cm D (add 7.1 cm F-B for utilities and door handle), 87 kg unpacked, freestanding, powder-coated 304 stainless steel. Interior 48.3 x 30.5 x 33 cm, 48 L. One front door opening left to right with T-handle high-compression latch; foamed-in-place polyurethane insulation with Teflon heat breaks. Cooling: LN2 injected through an injection ring via dual solenoid valves from a 22 psi (1.5 bar) low-pressure supply tank via a 6 ft braided stainless hose with 0.5 in 45-degree flare connectors (LN2 inlet on the back, per drawing labels LN2 INLET, POWER PLUG, REMOTE ALARM CONTACT, RS232/PC INTERFACE). Heating: 945 W 115 V tubular heater. Rates 0.1-99.9 C/min cooling, 0.1-10 C/min warming, +50 to -180 C. Air-handling system circulates chamber air (fan implied, speed not published). Touch-screen LCD on the front, no thermal printer on XV. Type T thermocouples for chamber and sample. Catalog 'Compressor: Air-cooled' on the product page is a web attribute conflicting with the LN2-injection design and is not modelled.
